                        ( p. 147 ) H برشا बर्षा barshā [S. वर्षा ], s.f. Rain; the rainy season ( = barsāt ): — barshā-bindu , s.m. Rain-drop: — barshā-r̤itu , barshā-r̤itu kāl , s.m. The rainy season. 2) برشات barshāt
                        ( p. 147 ) H برشات बर्षात barshāt , s.f. = barsāt , q.v. 3) برشاشن barshāśan
                        ( p. 147 ) H برشاشن बर्षाशन barshāśan , s.m. See s.v. = barsh . 4) برشانا barshānā
                        ( p. 147 ) H برشانا बर्षाना barshānā , v.t. = barsānā , q.v. 5) برشاو barshāʼū
                        ( p. 147 ) H برشاو बर्षाऊ barshāʼū , adj. = barsāʼū , q.v. 6) برشوڙي barshauṛī
                        ( p. 147 ) H برشوڙي बर्षौड़ी barshauṛī , adj. & s.f. = barsauṛī , q.v. Search Form • DDSA Close

A Dictionary of Urdu, Classical Hindi, and English. A Dictionary of Urdu, Classical Hindi, and English. Search for headword: 'दाई' 3 results Highlight text and press "t" to transliterate (devanagari script only) 1) دائی dāʼī
                        ( p. 504 ) H دائی दाई dāʼī [S. दायिकः i.e. दायिन् + कः ], adj. & s.m. Giving, bestowing; giver, &c. (com. used at the end of comp., e.g. dukh-dāʼī , q.v.). 2) دائي dāʼī
                        ( p. 504 ) H دائي दाई dāʼī [Prk. दत्तिआ ; S. दात्रिका rt. दा ], s.f. A nurse; a wet-nurse; a midwife; (local) a maid-servant; — the stand that children run to in playing hide-and-seek: — dāʼī aṣīl , s.f. A superior maid-servant, a lady's maid: — dāʼī-pilāʼī , s.f. A wet-nurse: — dāʼī-janāʼī , s.f. A midwife: — dāʼī-ko soṅpnā , v.t. To put out to nurse: — dāʼī-khilāʼī , s.f. A dry-nurse: — dāʼī-garī , s.f. Midwifery. 3) دائين dāʼīṅ
                        ( p. 505 ) H دائين दाईं dāʼīṅ [S. धामन् , rt. धा ; or ध्यामन् ], s.f. Equality (of age or size); measure, size: — dāʼīṅ-dār = dāʼīṅ-kā , adj. & s.m. (f. - ī ), Of equal age or size; — an equal (in age or size). Search Form • DDSA Close
